dependencyDashboardTitle: Dependency Dashboard: major versions on request
dependencyDashboardHeader:
## How to use this issue

Renovate keeps up to date the third-party software of the images this repository publishes as `openvidu/*` (MinIO, MinIO client, MongoDB, Loki, Mimir), their base images and the GitHub Actions. When an update is merged, the images it changes are rebuilt and published.

- **Minor and patch versions: nothing to do.** Renovate merges them by itself when CI passes.
- **Major versions: you decide.** They may need changes, so they are never applied by themselves. They wait under **Pending Approval**: tick one and Renovate opens its PR on its next run (daily, or run the Renovate workflow by hand). Review that PR and merge it by hand.

The other sections are information from Renovate:

| Section | What it is |
|---|---|
| **Pending Status Checks** | Updates that will be merged by themselves once they are 3 days old. Nothing to do. |
| **PR Closed (Blocked)** | Majors whose PR was closed without merging: Renovate does not propose them again. Tick one to bring its PR back. |
| **Open** | The PRs Renovate has open now. |
| **Detected Dependencies** | Everything Renovate keeps up to date, file by file. |
| **Repository Problems** | Warnings about Renovate's own setup. |

packageRules.description: One PR for every non-major update, merged automatically once CI passes.
A new major is a decision taken by hand. It opens no PR: the Dependency Dashboard lists it with a checkbox, and ticking it opens its own PR, never merged automatically.
Give new releases a few days before proposing them. Release dates of Docker Hub images need RENOVATE_DOCKER_MAX_PAGES in the Renovate workflow.
Stay on the MongoDB series set by MONGODB_MAJOR_MINOR in versions.env
